Title: External remote access outside authorized scope
Description: Identify successful external VPN or remote-support access into OT/DMZ that violates the approved account, route, target, or support authorization.
Detection_Logic: Join a successful gateway session to PAM/jump and destination logons; compare identity, source path, target and permitted action against the approval. Treat geography as enrichment and account for VPN/NAT.
Required_Telemetry_and_Fields: VPN/PAM/jump and target authentication; account, session_id, source/NAT address, target_asset, start/end, MFA result, approval_id.
Operational_Exceptions: Approved vendor windows, 24-hour operations, emergency access and alternate gateways.
Validation_Criteria: Replay authorized and out-of-scope sessions; verify a failed login alone cannot trigger successful-access classification.
Mapping_Confidence_and_Conditions: High if the specified behavior is evidenced
